glance_takeaway: An incident post-mortem for INC-1194, a 4h17m partial API outage on June 24, 2026. A search-query change (leading-wildcard pattern forcing full scans of a 274M-row table) triggered it, and two latent weaknesses — autovacuum debt (38.1M dead tuples) and jitterless retries exhausting a shared connection pool — amplified a one-endpoint regression into a platform-wide SEV-1, worsened by slow detection (~68 min; alerts watched error rate, not latency). Impact: peak ~31% requests failing, ~362k failed, 2,312 orgs, ~$41,300 SLA credits, no data lost; three P0 fixes land Q3 2026 (latency SLO alerts, pool-saturation alerts/isolation, jittered retries), one per failure leg — remove any one leg and it's a degradation, not an outage.

strengths: Exceptional encoding honesty: the bottom timeline is genuinely to scale (~4.24 px/min — every tick position matches its timestamp), duration bands (network hypothesis, pool pinned, VACUUM) are positioned correctly, and the one not-to-scale bar is explicitly labeled '(bars not to scale)'.

The causal structure is the layout: three numbered cause cards converge via colored arrows into the outage node, with a legend binding color to meaning (trigger/debt/amplification/mitigation) and each P0 fix cross-referenced to its failure leg.
Audience-fit glosses exactly as the brief requires: one-line italic explanations of dead tuples, autovacuum, and pgbouncer pooling sit inside the relevant cards.

Robust progressive build: 8-step motion with captions doubling as a visible, clickable ordered list; no-JS fallback renders the complete final frame; prefers-reduced-motion honored; all 16 key facts survive into a single static view.
weaknesses: The rollback-impossible / feature-flag takeaway (T3) is carried only by small timeline labels and step captions — it did not register in the 10-second glance, unlike the other three takeaways which own visual real estate.
SVG text runs as small as 9.5px; the timeline annotations and footnote caveats are hard to read without zooming, and the whole page being one SVG limits skimmable headings.

Some depth is shaved off: p50 latency, EXPLAIN cost, the misdiagnosis anchors (cloud advisory), the 90-second flag flip, and named remediation owners are all absent; the blameless framing is implicit rather than stated.
Below-the-fold content is just the step-caption list repeating the diagram — a reader wanting the fuller narrative (e.g. why the pool bump backfired) has nowhere to go.
evaluator_notes: Accuracy is formulaic: 16/16 facts conveyed in their core, 0 distorted, 0 contradicted → 10.0. Composite facts (F3, F4, F5, F13, F16) each omit sub-details but nothing meaning-altering; omissions are noted per fact. Glance scored from the recorded takeaway only: T1, T4 fully landed, T2 mostly (lag + wrong instrument, misdiagnosis story implicit), T3 missed → 7.5. Overall = 0.35*10 + 0.30*7.5 + 0.15*7.5 + 0.10*7.5 + 0.10*8.5 = 8.475 → 8.5. The final animation frame is the complete page, so the glance view and full view coincide — a deliberate strength of this design (nothing essential is hidden behind interaction).
